description:
Choi Ji-Hu works as secretary to Jung Da-Won, the CEO of Seungjin Corporation. On the surface, he seems like just another ordinary employee, but he’s hiding a dangerous secret - he’s received an offer promising an enormous sum of money in exchange for a damning video that could jeopardize Da-Won’s inheritance of the company. Hoping to make a big break, Ji-Hu carefully collects evidence in secret. But one day, he gets caught…by Da-Won himself! However, instead of reacting with anger, Da-Won jumps to an unpredictable conclusion: “Secretary Choi, do you love me?" Panicked, Ji-Hu blurts out a response without thinking: “Yes! I love you!” Having fallen head-over-heels for his secretary, Da-Won is about to show Ji-Hu what it means to be loved until you’re dog-tired!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three side story chapters.*
